summary: A challenger loses a council race by 44 votes, thinks about a recount, runs again two years later and wins by more than a hundred.
realLife: In New Bedford, a challenger lost the council seat race in 2021 by 44 votes to the incumbent, splitting the six precincts evenly. They ran again in 2023 and won 1,137 to 1,023, saying voters wanted change.
sources: The New Bedford Light, Choquette edges out Markey in the first council district, Nov 7, 2023: https://newbedfordlight.org/choquette-edges-out-markey-in-ward-1/
